Knowledge Absorption

The Collector (Charmed) is able to extract specific amounts of knowledge from the minds of their victims.

Power/Ability to:

Absorb knowledge

The power to absorb knowledge. Sub-power of Knowledge Manipulation. Variation of Absorption. Opposite to Knowledge Projection.

Contents

  • 1 Also Called
  • 2 Capabilities
  • 3 Applications
  • 4 Associations
  • 5 Limitations
  • 6 Known Users
  • 7 Known Objects
  • 8 Gallery
  • 9 Videos

Also Called[]

  • Information Absorption/Harvesting
  • Knowledge Harvesting
  • Osmosis

Capabilities[]

The user can absorb knowledge from others or objects such as books or computers and store the taken knowledge within their own minds. The knowledge absorption can be either instant absorption/learning/understanding or a slower process where the user integrates the knowledge without a risk of overflow. Some users can absorb either knowledge, experience, or both in various degrees.

Applications[]

  • Ability Learning
  • Brain Absorption
  • Data Absorption
  • Experience Absorption
  • Knowledge Augmentation
  • Knowledge Empowerment
  • Memory Absorption
  • Instant Learning
  • Intelligence Augmentation
  • Skill Absorption
  • Skill Enhancement

Associations[]

  • Absorption
  • Knowledge Manipulation
  • Knowledge Replication
  • Memory Manipulation
  • Telepathy

Limitations[]

  • Psychic Shield (highly resistant) and Psychic Immunity (impervious) if done through psychic methods.
  • May have to assimilate or consume another to obtain knowledge.
  • Users of Absorption Immunity/Absorption Negation

Gallery[]

A Seeker (Charmed) absorbs knowledge from a victim.
Brainiac (DC Comics)
Abzorbaloff (Doctor Who)
Namekiand like Piccolo (Dragon Ball series) can use an ancient Namekian technique to merge with others of their kind, gaining access to the the other's knowledge and memories.
Alucard (Hellsing) is able to gain access to the knowledge and memories of others by drinking their blood.
Freddy Krueger (A Nightmare on Elm Street) has acquired the knowledge and skills of his victims, such as martial arts talent, by absorbing their souls.
Ann Marie LeBeau/Rogue (Marvel Comics)
Using the Cranial Disruption, Death's Head (Marvel Comics) can download an opponent's mind into himself, absorbing their knowledge, experience, tactics, and combat skills.
As an Osmosian, Kevin Levin (Ben 10) can absorb knowledge and memories through physical contact.
Alex Mercer (Prototype) can gain the knowledge, skills, and memories of others by consuming them.
Naraku (InuYasha)
Legendary Knowledge Magisword (Mighty Magiswords) can be used to steal its target's knowledge.
Brainiac (Smallville) in the process of absorbing information from the mind of his creator Dax-Ur.
During assimilation/replication processes, The Thing (John Carpenter's The Thing) gains the knowledge of its victims, making it become more intelligent.
After a shard of the AllSpark/Cube fall out of a sweater, it imprints a large collection of ancient transformed Cybertronian knowledge onto Sam Witwicky's (Transformers film series) brain, which shortly thereafter begins to see strange symbols right in the middle of his position.
Echo Mouse (The Owl House)
